features.heading: Make gaming a great hobby
features.subheading: Gaming is a hobby just like any other — better with good friends and with a professional Game Educator who is there to guide and help.

minecraftClubs.title: Every lesson has a Gedu
minecraftClubs.description: Our Game Educators — Gedus — are gamers themselves. They understand that as children, identity and friendships are built both online and offline. Every lesson is guided by someone who truly gets it.

screenTime.title: Designed to build real skills
screenTime.description: Skilfully designed clubs turn gaming into a playful learning experience where children develop real skills and have fun doing what they love.

newFriends.title: New friends, real connections
newFriends.description: Children build genuine, lasting friendships through shared adventures. No one is left without a friend. The gamer’s oath means treating each other with kindness — online and offline.

parents.title: Parents are part of it
parents.description: Parental game education is just as important as the clubs themselves. We keep you informed, involved, and equipped to support your child’s gaming journey.

safety.heading: How is my child kept safe?

vetted.title: Record checks required
vetted.description: We require every Gedu to show us a criminal record extract for working with children before we certify them.

noDirectMessages.title: Every chat is the whole group’s
noDirectMessages.description: Chat in a lesson goes to the whole room, where the Gedu can see it.

groupOnlyRooms.title: Only the group gets in
groupOnlyRooms.description: A club’s voice room opens five minutes before the lesson and closes five minutes after it, and only that group, its Gedus and our staff can enter.

notRecorded.title: Lessons are not recorded
notRecorded.description: Nothing in the app records, transcribes or stores the voice or video of a lesson.

parentPin.title: A PIN before any spending
parentPin.description: Buying anything needs a four-digit parent PIN that only you know, and your child can’t get into your parent account without it.

safety.faqLink: Read the full answers in our FAQ

howItWorks.heading: Learning by Gaming.
howItWorks.subheading: How it works: join a club, camp or event in three simple steps.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.description: Sign up as a parent and create gamer accounts for your children.

step2.title: Pick a club
step2.description: Browse our clubs and enrol your gamers in the ones that fit their schedule and interests.

step3.title: Join the adventure
step3.description: Your gamers log in each week, meet their Gedu, and dive into the adventure with new friends.

cta.heading: Ready to turn gaming into learning?
cta.subheading: Give your child a place to play, learn and make friends every week, with a Game Educator in every lesson and every chat open to the whole group.
cta.whereWeAre: Our online clubs run in {languages}, for families anywhere in the world. And our global headquarters? A cosy studio in Lauttasaari, Helsinki, Finland, on a quiet little island.
